metadata.title: Yahoo Finance test drives Mercedes-Benz's new luxury EV, the CLA 250+

content.text:
Mercedes-Benz (MBG.DE, MBGAF) is shifting into high gear with a new luxury EV designed to better compete with Tesla's (TSLA) Model 3.
Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian comes on Market Domination Overtime to discuss his test driving of the new CLA 250+ electric sedan.
We're shifting gears now. Yahoo Finance senior autos reporter Pras Subramanian, join me now with a demo of the Mercedes-Benz CLA 250. All right, Pras, what do we need to know? Bring us up to speed.
I first got to say I'm wearing my Spain jersey. I don't want I don't want to look out of place here with the German car. But yeah, you know, Mercedes has had EVs for a while and they had sort of controversial styling, very swoopy and blob like, but now Mercedes sort of uh rejiggered that and when the new CLA 250 plus EV is their latest attempt to correct some of these design issues and it has a more of a attractive car, a sort of Model 3 kind of footprint, a smaller sedan. and I think it's quite nice. I think they did a great job both with on the outside here. I think they did a phenomenal job with lighting and sort of the the the profile here. Not not too, you know, like blob-like, right? a little bit more aggressive. Uh interior-wise also, very nice in there, very Mercedes, uh elevated experience. and this is also just the base car, right? So, this car starts at $45,000. So I think that's a pretty good value. And and for people like you Josh, it's gonna be a gas-powered hybrid as well.
Oh, that's what we like to hear. Let me ask you this. You, you know, you didn't just report on this car, you drove it. How did it feel? Were you impressed?
I had to drive it. I had to do it. Uh so I got they Mercedes has it in as their test fleet and I was able to get it for a weekend and I I was it's the CLA 250 Plus is just the rear rear wheel drive car. Excuse me. So excuse me. Excuse me there. So basically, 250 horsepower doesn't sound like much, but it's all at the torque is right off the top here. It's very quick, very dart. I very maneuverable, uh not too heavy for an EV. I thought it actually performed really well and it was actually, again, like I said, a nice place to be, so very comfortable. It drove a nice pep to it. Now, you're not going to go past 80 miles an hour. It's not that powerful of a car. I mean, you can, but it's like it's going to sort of top out at that kind of speed. But for anyone who's living in the city, suburbs, etc, a great commuter car. Uh and the way I see it is it's a luxury alternative, right? To like let's say a Model 3.
Uh well I was going to ask you with this new car, who are they taking on here? Who's the competition?
There's not that much there in the sedan space, EV sedan space, especially at that at that at that price. you're talking about, like I said, the Tesla Model 3, maybe a Hyundai Ioniq 5, but that's more of a hatchback. It's really aimed at the I think the Tesla Model 3 and the Model 3 is a great car. It's a fantastic car, but it's not exactly a luxury car, right? It's a very it's a premium, it's it's very comfortable, but you know, at $45,000, the Tesla version of that car, real world drive Model 3 is about 38. So you're comparable there, right? a little comparable there. Uh now the car I had of course was optioned up to about 65,000. So that's that's a bit much. The Tesla Premium all-wheel drive is around 47. So there's a big difference there, but you're getting a lot. I mean, you had three different screens in the front, you had a lot of different options, a lot of different uh comfortable comfort features that that you don't have in the Tesla versus the Mercedes. So, I think it's a different type of of a buyer, but at the same time, if you want to go $45,000, you could do that and you could go in a Mercedes. So, I think it's a great value proposition. Also, I want to note 380 miles in that that base version. So that's that's a lot there. A lot of money, a lot of EV there for the car you're into that kind of thing.
Pras Subramanian, thank you, buddy.
Mhm.
Plus another launch to highlight here at Yahoo Finance. There's a new hub to check out on the website dedicated to autos and EVs. We're bringing you expert coverage from Yahoo Finance and other leading publishers to find out more about Yahoo Finance's autos hub, click the QR code on your screen.
